comments: Registered as one bank: cage and plinth share one scale and one baseline (the plinth base); the source pivot x is the centre of the plinth base.
The tall cage sets the shared scale, so the plinth is narrower than the 16 px canvas.
Contrast note: the dull orb and the dark iron cage are the weakest-contrast state of the five banks; the pale plinth carries the silhouette on a dark floor.
geometry: Collision is one tile and belongs to the rules; art never sets a hitbox. The stage stamps the frame bottom-centre at the tile centre x and one half tile below the tile centre y (the tile foot).
mapping_basis: Visual review of the delivered sheet and its measured crops, 2026-10-18. Reading order equals the request order: the five cells share one cage and plinth; the orb is dull in the first cell (out-0) and bright aqua in the next four (lit-0..3).

pieces.label: out-0: dull slate-teal orb with one small glint; visually unlit.
pieces.name: out-0

pieces.label: lit-0: bright aqua orb, centred pale core.
pieces.name: lit-0

pieces.label: lit-1: aqua orb, raised flame-like core.
pieces.name: lit-1

pieces.label: lit-3: aqua orb, lowered core to the right.
pieces.name: lit-3

size_basis: native canvas 16x22, anchor bottom-centre (8,22); stage 384x224 at 16 px per tile; a knight is 16x16; the great brazier is a lantern-cage on a stone plinth, about 1.4 knights tall.
timing: out 12 ticks; lit 4x4 ticks (30 Hz). Art never sets a hitbox (collision is one tile).
